Title: A Contactless App-Based Intervention to Improve Health Behaviors in Airline Pilots: A Randomized Trial
Author: Daniel Wilson, Matthew W. Driller, Ben Johnston, Nicholas D. Gill
Comment: The p-value is reported as p<0.001; 0.001 is stored as the reported threshold, not an exact equality. Table 2 displays change CIs as -2.2 (1.9-2.5) and -0.2 (0.2-0.5), with unsigned CI bounds; values were transcribed verbatim and signs were not inferred. Change-score SDs are not reported, so they remain null. The reported d=-0.23 is retained verbatim rather than sign-harmonized. The paper reports a significant time × group interaction but also states that the direct between-group difference across time points for body mass was not significant.
